claims.statement: Tom Allen fired bullets at the Ohio saloon, a rival across the street that had taken his customers.
claims.excerpt:
Fired Bullets at a Rival Saloon That
Had Gotten His Customers.
places: Ohio saloon, lower Market Street, St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen was in Police Court on a dual charge of disturbing the peace and carrying concealed weapons.
claims.excerpt:
to answer the dual charge
of disturbing the peace

claims.statement: Allen's case was continued until April 30 (printed as 'April ov.').

claims.statement: Tom Allen ran his own place of amusement, a dance hall, on lower Market Street.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Allen talked about how square he had always run his place, and how he had kept within the law.

notes: Shooting is stated in the headline; the body text is garbled in places. The quote is reported speech. The night is not dated (paper dated 1897-04-27); the continuance is read as April 30 with low confidence.
